'''Hart and Parn Starships''' was a family [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] business located on [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]]. Circa [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it was owned by [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla|Fiolla]], who expanded its operations to include [[Starship/Legends|starship]] sales and repair. Around this time, it was visited by Rebel operative [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], along with [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak]] and [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], as well as [[Mammon Hoole]]. A former actor named [[Garik Loran]] later stole an [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]] from the store, but planned on asking her about buying it later.
